name: EBS Snapshot Sharing
description: An attacker with ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute adds create volume permission for an external account (or all accounts via group 'all'). The attacker's account uses ec2:CopySnapshot to copy the snapshot, then creates a volume and mounts it to extract data. This exfiltrates the full contents of the source volume. Unencrypted snapshots are fully readable. Required permission is ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute. The attacker needs ec2:CopySnapshot in their account.
